cli.help:
ihd - Exact Arithmetic Calculator

Usage:
  ihd [flags] [expression]
  ihd [flags]                (Starts interactive REPL)
  echo "expr" | ihd [flags]   (Evaluates piped input)

Flags:
  --lang      Set language locale (e.g., en, ja)
  --ascii     Output using standard ASCII text (e.g., sqrt, pi) instead of Unicode
  --approx    Display approximate decimal value alongside exact form
  --latex     Output expression in LaTeX format ($$ ... $$)
  --pretty    Output expression using 2D pretty-printed formatting
  --deg       Use degree mode for trigonometric and inverse trigonometric functions
  --explain   Show step-by-step algebraic rewriting explanations
  -h, --help  Show this help message
cli.flag_deg: Use degree mode for trigonometric and inverse trigonometric functions
cli.flag_verify: Autonomously verify algebraic correctness and print certificate
cli.flag_lean: Output calculation result and verification certificate as Lean 4 formal proof code
cli.flag_lean_file: Save Lean 4 formal proof code to specified .lean file path
cli.lean_file_saved: Lean 4 formal proof code saved to: %s
cli.err_run_script_required: run requires a script file path: ihd run <file.ihd>

verify.integral_holds: Derivative identity diff(F, %s) - f == 0 holds (Matches integrand)
verify.ode_holds: Substitution residual in ODE evaluates to 0 (Solution satisfies equation)
verify.factor_holds: Factor expansion expand(factors) - P == 0 holds (Matches original polynomial)
verify.solve_holds: Substitution residual evaluates to 0 for all roots (All roots satisfy equation)
verify.matrix_inv_holds: Matrix product A * inv(A) - I == O holds (Identity matrix confirmed)
verify.matrix_lu_holds: P * A - L * U == O holds (Row permutation and LU triangular factors confirmed)
verify.matrix_qr_holds: Q^T * Q == I and A - Q * R == O hold (Orthogonality and QR decomposition confirmed)
verify.matrix_cholesky_holds: A - L * L^T == O holds (Cholesky decomposition confirmed)
verify.matrix_ldlt_holds: A - L * D * L^T == O holds (LDLT decomposition confirmed)
verify.matrix_pinv_holds: Penrose condition A * A^+ * A == A holds (Pseudoinverse confirmed)
verify.rational_apart_holds: Recombination together(apart) - f == 0 holds (Partial fractions confirmed)
verify.gcd_bezout_holds: Bezout identity s*A + t*B - G == 0 holds (Extended GCD confirmed)
verify.wz_holds: Wilf-Zeilberger difference equation Delta_n(F) == Delta_k(G) holds (WZ certificate confirmed)
verify.sturm_holds: Sturm sign variation difference V(a) - V(b) == 1 holds (Root isolation confirmed)
verify.dual_holds: Dual round-trip transformation matches original expression
verify.general_holds: Algebraic zero reduction expand(L - R) == 0 holds (Identical expressions)
verify.refuted_residual: Verification residual did not reduce to zero: residual = %s
verify.unsupported_domain: Autonomous verification checker is not defined for this domain
